description: This file provides functions and data structures for interacting with an inbucket email testing service, including retrieving, deleting mailboxes, fetching messages, downloading attachments, and retry logic.

methods.name: ParseEmail
methods.description: Extracts the username part of an email address before the '@' symbol.

methods.name: GetMailBox
methods.description: Fetches mailbox headers for a given email address.

methods.name: GetMessageFromMailbox
methods.description: Retrieves a specific email message by ID from a mailbox, including downloading attachments.

methods.name: downloadAttachment
methods.description: Downloads an attachment from a URL and returns its bytes.

methods.name: DeleteMailBox
methods.description: Deletes the mailbox associated with an email address.

methods.name: RetryInbucket
methods.description: Retries a callback function a specified number of times with delays.

methods.name: getInbucketHost
methods.description: Constructs the inbucket host URL from environment variables or defaults.
